tools.name: home_assistant_states
tools.title: Home Assistant devices
tools.description: The user's smart home devices in Home Assistant and their states now: lights (detail: brightness), switches, fans, covers, climate, media players, locks, scenes, scripts, automations and buttons, as JSON [{id, name, state, area, detail}]. The whole home is a long list: give search (a room, a device's name, part of an id) when you know what you are looking for. sensors adds temperatures, humidity, motion and door contacts; use it only with search ("temperature", "lämpötila", a room), as a home has hundreds of them. The id is what home_assistant_set takes.

search.description: Only devices whose name, area or id has this text (any case)

sensors.description: Sensors and binary sensors too (read only)

tools.name: home_assistant_set
tools.title: Switch a Home Assistant device
tools.description: Put one Home Assistant device in a state: on or off (lights, switches, fans, climate, media players; an automation is enabled or disabled), open or close (covers), lock or unlock (locks), run (a scene, a script, a button; triggers an automation). The user allows it on Nightdrive's confirmation card first, which shows the device and the state; a refusal there is their answer. Find the device's id with home_assistant_states. Answers with the device's state afterwards.

entity.title: Device
entity.description: The device's id, as home_assistant_states gives it (light.kitchen)
